mapper.select: select s.supplier_id as supplier_id, s.supplier_name as supplier_name, pr.person_id as person_id, p.name as person_name, case when pr.relation_kind = '持股' then concat(if(pr.relation_type = '本人','本人','亲属'),'持股') when pr.relation_kind = '任职' then concat(if(pr.relation_type = '本人','本人','亲属'),'任职') when pr.relation_kind in ('兼职取酬','劳务报酬') then '兼职取酬' when pr.relation_kind = '实际控制' then '实际控制' else '其他' end as link_type, pr.hold_ratio as hold_ratio, concat('关联关系申报 relation_id=', pr.relation_id, '（', pr.relation_type, '/', pr.relation_kind, '，来源:', pr.data_source, '）') as evidence, '系统比对' as source_type from jc_person_relation pr join jc_supplier s on s.del_flag = '0' and ( (pr.ent_credit_code <> '' and pr.ent_credit_code = s.credit_code) or (pr.ent_credit_code = '' and pr.ent_name <> '' and pr.ent_name = s.supplier_name)) left join jc_person p on p.person_id = pr.person_id and p.del_flag = '0' where pr.del_flag = '0' and (pr.ent_name <> '' or pr.ent_credit_code <> '')

select s.supplier_id as supplier_id, s.supplier_name as supplier_name, cd.person_id as person_id, p.name as person_name, case ci.item_type when '经商办企业' then '本人持股' when '对外投资' then '本人持股' when '关联交易' then '本人持股' when '兼职取酬' then '兼职取酬' when '劳务报酬' then '兼职取酬' when '亲属从业' then '亲属任职' else '其他' end as link_type, ci.hold_ratio as hold_ratio, concat('利益冲突申报 declare_id=', cd.declare_id, ' 明细 item_id=', ci.item_id, '（', ci.item_type, '）') as evidence, '系统比对' as source_type from jc_conflict_item ci join jc_conflict_declare cd on cd.declare_id = ci.declare_id and cd.del_flag = '0' join jc_supplier s on s.del_flag = '0' and ( (ci.ent_credit_code <> '' and ci.ent_credit_code = s.credit_code) or (ci.ent_credit_code = '' and ci.ent_name <> '' and ci.ent_name = s.supplier_name)) left join jc_person p on p.person_id = cd.person_id and p.del_flag = '0' where ci.del_flag = '0' and (ci.ent_name <> '' or ci.ent_credit_code <> '')
